algorithm_invariants.reparameterization_recovery: unchanged Ala transaction with bicriteria merge

cost_definition.optimization_total_nf: sum of joint energy-force cache misses over all 22 images

stages.name: smoke
stages.purpose: verify the full update, mandatory reparameterization, recovery, and force-call ledger

stages.name: ala_anchor
stages.purpose: test the best Ala setting directly at the current Chignolin first-passage window

stages.name: sequential_three_parameter_screen
stages.rule: scan alpha first at r=0.5,m_max=5; scan all r at the best alpha; scan all m_max at the best alpha and r; extend the best three settings to 5000 internal NF
stages.tie_break: lower I_perp at the same measured total NF, then lower sparse barrier

stages.name: interaction_expansion_if_needed
stages.rule: if sequential tuning does not beat current V9 IVM, expand within the registered alpha-r-m_max Cartesian grid, prioritizing neighboring and then all remaining settings; no fourth control is allowed

final_selection.primary: minimum measured total NF at which both the registered I_perp and densified barrier thresholds are satisfied
final_selection.secondary: lower I_perp and densified barrier at total NF not exceeding 5000
final_selection.dense_protocol: 10 then 20 subdivisions per segment; refine to 40 and 80 when successive barriers differ by more than 0.05 kcal/mol
final_selection.success_against_current_ivm: strictly lower joint first-passage total NF than the current IVM, or a strict Pareto improvement at matched total NF

extra_technique_gate.acceptance_condition: the same technique and the same basic alpha-r-m_max settings must also improve the best relevant IR-IVM results in both BB and Ala
